svg.title: Choose a runner according to the work a job does: Register another project runner while a job still needs its checkout helper
svg.text: Choose a runner according to the work a job does
Scenario: Register another project runner while a job still needs its checkout helper

g.text: Given the first project's job is running and still has to upload its artifact
This story checks the test suite's own runner setup, not a toolbox feature. The page of the first project's job: it is
Running, and its log stops on the loop "$ while [ ! -f /tmp/job-release ]; do sleep 1; done", where the job waits.
No "Uploading artifacts" section yet. GitLab Runner will upload result.txt later, through the job's checkout helper
When the second project registers its own runner
The second project's CI/CD settings, Runners section. Its one runner carries the saas-linux-medium-amd64 tag and has run
no job yet: GitLab lists it Offline and Idle. It was registered in the same runner service while the first job was still
Then GitLab accepts the first job artifact and marks the job as passed
The first job's page once its script is released. It Passed: its log shows "Uploading artifacts for successful job",
"result.txt: found 1 matching artifact files and directories" and "201 Created", and its side panel offers the artifact

svg.text: Storyboard e2e · 3 steps · 3 frames · every frame is its own pixel baseline (tolerance: 0)
● Given: stage ● When: actions ● Then: proofs
